descriptionText:
TwoWay builds next-gen software with traders, for traders.
We optimize trading workflows in financial institutions, transforming high-volume chat messages into structured market data in real time. This helps traders stay ahead of the market, cut operational risk, and save time — all while fitting into existing workflows and screen space.
We collaborate closely with top-tier EU and US investment banks and other financial institutions to solve real, complex problems that matter.
Our promise:
🔒 Operational efficiency – Reduce manual errors and mitigate operational risk at scale
📈 Performance under pressure – In volatile markets, boost desk efficiency and capture more revenue
🌍 Client & market impact – Help desks deliver sharper prices, serve more clients, and scale with leaner teams
We deeply care about:
🚀 Performance – real-time, zero-latency data processing that enhances decision-making and pricing accuracy.
🎯 Design – user-centric from day one, tailored for the complex realities of trading desks.
🌍 Impact – enabling traders to operate more efficiently in stressful environments and helping banks better serve their clients.
If this resonates with you — if you're excited by our mission, thrive in high-stakes, high-impact environments, and are curious, open, and always learning — we’d love to hear from you.
Vos missions
You will report directly to our CTO, which is an amazing opportunity to learn fast and grow.
As a Software Engineer Intern at TwoWay, you’ll be part of a fast-moving team building critical tools for investment bank traders. This is not a typical internship — you’ll work on real features, contribute to core product decisions, and ship code that goes into production.
You’ll collaborate closely with senior engineers, product designers, and the founders. From day one, you’ll be trusted with meaningful responsibility and given the support to learn and grow quickly.
As a key member of the team, you’ll do the following missions:

Build and improve core features of our web application, from backend logic to frontend UI
Contribute to the design and architecture of new components and APIs
Collaborate with the product team to understand user needs and translate them into clean, maintainable code
Write tests and participate in code reviews to maintain high code quality
Investigate and fix bugs in a fast-paced production environment
Learn best practices in software development, DevOps, and product iteration in a startup setting


We are looking for a 6 to 12-month internship, starting as soon as possible.
Vos compétences
You’d be a great fit if you

Build Fullstack Products: You’re comfortable working across the stack — with experience or strong interest in modern frameworks like SvelteKit on the frontend and NestJS or Node.js on the backend. You love shipping features end-to-end.
Thrive in Fast-Paced Environments: You’re energized by startups. You enjoy learning quickly, taking initiative, and iterating fast in a dynamic, high-growth setting.
Care About UX and Details: You pay attention to UI/UX consistency, performance, and believe the best software feels as good as it works.
Think Long-Term: You understand the importance of clean code, maintainability, and security, even when moving fast.
Stay Curious and Data-Informed: You ask questions, seek feedback, and back decisions with evidence. You’re not afraid to challenge assumptions and improve how things are done.
Are a Strong Communicator: You explain technical ideas clearly, ask for help when needed, and enjoy collaborating with product and design peers.


Avantages
At TwoWay, we’re building category-defining software for global investment banks — and doing it with a team that values speed, ownership, and real impact. If you’re sharp, driven, and thrive in fast-paced, high-stakes environments, you’ll feel right at home.
We’re a small, tight-knit team where:
🧠 Ideas move fast
💪 Talent is trusted
⚡ Execution beats hierarchy
We believe in clarity over fluff, shipping over perfection, and impact over ego.
🌍 TwoWay is a hybrid company with teammates across France and Europe. Our HQ is at Station F in Paris — the world’s largest startup campus and home to a thriving tech ecosystem.
✨ What you’ll get:

🤝 Work with curious, ambitious people who care deeply about what they build
🏦 See your code deployed at top-tier EU & US financial institutions
🔓 Full trust, real autonomy, and the ability to grow faster than anywhere else
🌐 Flexible setup: full remote, full office, or anything in between
💸 Competitive compensation with real upside


🚫 What we don’t care about:

🎓 Fancy résumés or name-drop schools
🧺 Free laundry or gimmicky perks
⏱ Clocking hours — we measure outcomes, not input


Want to build with us? We’d love to hear from you!
Our hiring process
We keep our process fast, clear, and respectful of your time. Here’s what to expect:

Intro call – A 30-minute conversation to get to know each other and align on expectations
Case study – A practical exercise to understand how you think and work
Founder interview – A deeper discussion with one of our cofounders to assess mutual fit and ambition
Offer – If it’s a match, we move fast to get you on board

You’ll get transparent communication at every step. We want this to be as much about you evaluating us as the other way around.

descriptionText:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

Specs Inc. is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Snap Inc. dedicated to making computing more human. The company develops Specs, advanced eyewear that seamlessly integrates digital experiences into the physical world. Specs feature see-through lenses that place digital objects directly into three-dimensional space, powered by Snap OS, a proprietary, context-aware operating system designed for natural interaction with your hands and voice.

Specs Inc. also provides Lens Studio, a full suite of advanced developer tools that powers immersive augmented reality experiences across Specs, Snapchat, and other services. We’re looking for a Research Engineer to join the Spectacles BCI Team at Snap Inc.!

In this role, you will be working on the state of the art of machine learning (ML) for time series data, developing the next generation of wearable device sensing. Working from our Paris office (9th arrondissement), you will be collaborating closely with other Specs hardware and software teams around the world.

What you’ll do:

Conduct focused, product-related research projects, defining hypotheses and designing experiments using electrophysiological and cognitive data. Review relevant literature and translate scientific knowledge into modeling approaches aligned with product needs. Build signal-processing and ML pipelines for noisy, real-world time-series sensor data. Develop algorithms and ML models for cognitive and physiological decoding using multimodal biological signals captured via wearable devices.. Nature & Culture International (NCI) is a highly effective conservation organization working to protect tropical forests and biodiversity in South America. Over the past 30 years, it has conserved over 29 million acres in 211 protected areas across the Andes and Amazon by putting local communities at the center of the work rather than treating them as bystanders. The organization works primarily in Ecuador, Peru, Colombia, and Bolivia, partnering with Indigenous groups, traditional communities, governments, and regional allies to protect land for the long term. Country teams lead conservation work on the ground, with headquarters in Loja, Ecuador, anchoring field operations and offices throughout the region.
The CEO is the organization’s chief fundraiser and its lead representative in the United States. This person leads the U.S. team, focuses on cultivating major institutional and individual donors, and builds partnerships that scale conservation work across Latin America. It’s a role for a leader who can tell a compelling story, build lasting donor relationships, and turn field results into sustained giving.
The job, at its core, is to fund the next stage of growth. Conservation is why the organization exists; revenue is what makes it possible. Progressivement, vous gagnerez en autonomie sur vos projets pour faire de cette expérience un vrai accélérateur de carrière. Vous découvrirez également toute la diversité de nos métiers, dans un secteur qui évolue et innove en permanence.
